name: russia_far_east_map
description: Russian Far East map in world_map / china_map style, no labels, no borders: Primorye and Khabarovsk coast, NE China (Manchuria) with the Amur and Songhua as thin blue lines and Lake Khanka, the Korean peninsula, the Sea of Japan and Sea of Okhotsk in light blue with white wave ticks, Sakhalin, Hokkaido and northern Honshu, flat green land, dark green coast, Sikhote-Alin mountain ticks, black frame. 1000x800, centre anchor. Projection 28 px/deg: x = (lon - 129.65) x 28, y = -(lat - 48.77) x 28 (lon 111.8..147.5 E, lat 34.5..63.1 N). Sikhote-Alin reserve (135.9E, 45.2N) = (+175, +100), left clear for a ring marker.
